product_name_specific: EQ fortwo cabrio, EQ fortwo coupe
risk_description:
The screw between the rear axle and the body can come loose, causing
disconnection or even complete detachment of the centre bearing of the rear axle from the body. In this case, the wheel guidance can be lost, creating a risk of an accident.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
